sentences.text: 3. FIR in Crime No.8/2023 was registered by Hassan Rural Police Station, Hassan, against the petitioner herein for the aforesaid offences on the basis of the first information received from respondent no.2 who is the grandmother of the victim girl aged about 13 years.
During the course of investigation, petitioner was arrested and remanded to judicial custody on 21.01.2023.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.

Bail application filed by the petitioner NC:
2024:KHC:33040 before the Trial Court in Spl.C.No.191/2023 was rejected on 05.05.2023.
Therefore, he is before this Court.
4. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is aged about 61 years and he has no criminal antecedents.
He has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has seriously opposed the petition.
6. The material on record would go to show that the house of the petitioner is situated near the house of the first informant and her daughter who is the mother of the victim girl.
Victim girl aged about 13 years is stated to be mentally retarded, and therefore, she was not admitted to school.
On 20.01.2023 at about 3.00 p.m., the victim girl who was playing outside their house was found missing after sometime.
On enquiry, the first informant was informed by her neighbour that petitioner had taken the victim girl to his house.

Immediately, the first informant rushed towards Papanna vs State By Police Sub Inspector on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58943389/
2 the house of the petitioner and found the chappal of the victim outside his house.

sentences.text:
She, NC:
2024:KHC:33040 therefore, knocked the door of the petitioner's house.

Since the door was not opened, she kicked open the door and went inside the house and found that her minor granddaughter was lying naked inside the house in a semi-conscious status, and there was blood near her private parts.
When the first informant tried to question the petitioner, he allegedly ran away from the house.

Immediately thereafter, police was summoned to the spot and the victim was shifted to the Hassan Government Hospital, and thereafter, the first informant had approached the police.
7.

The medical records of the victim girl who appears to be mentally retarded would go to show that the doctor who had medically examined the victim immediately after the incident had found bleeding in her vagina and also redness in her private parts.
Linear abrasion was also noted on the right breast of the victim and a scratch mark over mons pubis.
The victim girl has also made allegations against the petitioner before the Magistrate who has recorded her statement under Section 164 Cr.PC.
The victim girl and her parents are yet to be examined before the Trial Court.

Petitioner who is staying nearby the house of the first informant and the victim, may NC:
2024:KHC:33040 tamper with the prosecution witnesses in the event he is enlarged on bail.

8. Considering the gravity of allegations, the medical evidence of the victim girl and also the fact that the petitioner stays in the neighbourhood of the victim and her parents, I am of the opinion that at this stage, petitioner's prayer for grant of regular bail cannot be entertained.
Accordingly, petition is dismissed.

SD/-
